title: Death Sound Nether
description: Your fallen pets echo from the Nether. Hear their ghostly voices and the sounds of how they died drifting through the darkness.
body:
**Death Sound Nether** brings your fallen tamed pets back as ghostly echoes in the Nether.

When your wolf, cat, horse, or other tamed companion dies, their memory haunts you. Every time you enter the Nether, you'll hear them — sometimes their living voice (a howl, a meow, a neigh), sometimes the sound of how they died (an explosion, a splash, the crackle of fire), always distant and muffled, as if calling from beyond.

## Features
- **Tracks your tamed pets** — wolves, cats, parrots, horses, donkeys, mules, llamas, skeleton horses, zombie horses
- **Haunting sounds in the Nether** — every 1-3 minutes, a random ghostly sound plays near you
- **Death cause matters** — explosion deaths echo as explosions, fire deaths crackle, falls crunch, drownings splash
- **Your pet's own voice** — 50% of the time you'll hear their normal ambient sound, like they're still with you
- **Max 5 memories** — the 5 most recent pet deaths are remembered (oldest fades away)
- **Distant and muffled** — sounds come from 4-8 blocks away with low volume and deep pitch, creating an eerie, haunting atmosphere

## How It Works
1. Your tamed pet dies
2. Their entity type and death cause are stored
3. When you enter the Nether, ghostly sounds begin
4. Each sound is randomly chosen from your fallen pets — their ambient voice or their death moment

## Supported Pets
| Pet | Ambient Sound |
|-----|---------------|
| Wolf | Howl |
| Cat | Meow |
| Parrot | Chirp |
| Horse | Neigh |
| Donkey | Bray |
| Mule | Bray |
| Llama | Bleat |
| Skeleton Horse | Rattle |
| Zombie Horse | Groan |

## Death Cause Sounds
| Death | Sound |
|-------|-------|
| Explosion (Creeper, TNT, bed) | 💥 Explosion boom |
| Fall damage | 🦴 Crunch |
| Drowning | 💧 Splash |
| Fire / Lava | 🔥 Crackle |
| Other | Pet's own voice |

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge or Fabric loader

## No Configuration Needed
Just install and play. Tame a pet, lose it, and visit the Nether. Your companion will find you there.
